notes: Each card restates a teaching method in original words. No book text, page, diagram or illustration is copied or bundled.

Book references point at data/creative_books_200_index.json ids (ART-xxx), at the user's own library (UBK-xx, read in this session from the user's copies) or, for other titles, at bibliographic metadata only (EXT-xxx). review_status says how much was really read.

user_copy_read_paraphrased means the card was written after reading that book's text (text layer or OCR) or, for picture books, its rendered sample pages; it does not mean every page was studied line by line, and nothing from the book is redistributed.
A card is guidance for planning and checking a drawing. It does not prove that Claude draws at a professional level; only rendered artifacts checked against the card's checks can show that.
Executable demonstrations live in scripts/drawing_methods.py (draw head|figure|character|forms|bounce|shadow). They are original code, deterministic, and write editable layered SVG.

review_status_levels.general_teaching_knowledge: Method summarised from the widely taught content associated with the book; the book's full text was not read in this session.
review_status_levels.public_domain_section_read: A public-domain section was read (see A14 for the anchors).
review_status_levels.bibliographic_metadata_only: External book entries only: title and author are recorded; no content was reviewed.
review_status_levels.user_copy_read_paraphrased: The user's own copy was read in this session (text layer, OCR or rendered sample pages) and the method was paraphrased; no text or image is kept or redistributed.

external_books.title: The Artist's Complete Guide to Facial Expression
external_books.author: Gary Faigin

methods.name_en: Contour and negative space
methods.principle_ar: ارسم ما تراه لا ما تعرفه: تتبّع حافة الشكل ببطء كأن القلم يلمسه، وارسم الفراغات بين الأشياء كأشكال مستقلة؛ الفراغ السالب يكشف أخطاء النسب التي يخفيها الرمز الذهني.
methods.principle_en: Draw what you see, not the symbol you know: trace the edge slowly as if touching it, and draw the gaps between things as shapes of their own; negative shapes expose proportion errors that the mental symbol hides.
steps: Pick one edge and follow it continuously
Draw the shape of the empty space between two forms
Compare each negative shape's width to its height
Only then connect contours into the object
Draw shapes, not things: large shapes first, then secondary, then enrichment shapes such as reflections and labels
Keep restating searching lines instead of erasing every first attempt
methods.code_recipe: Build the outline as one continuous SVG path; draw negative-space polygons on a separate 'guide' layer and compare their bounding boxes with the reference.
checks: Negative shapes match the reference within 5% of the frame
No symbol-like eyes or hands drawn from memory over the observed shape
common_errors: Drawing the icon of an eye instead of its observed shape
Ignoring the space between arm and torso

methods.name_en: Sighting, measuring and plumb lines
methods.principle_ar: اختر وحدة قياس واحدة (طول الرأس مثلًا) وقِس بها كل شيء، وأسقط خطوطًا رأسية وأفقية وهمية لتعرف ما يقع فوق ما؛ الزوايا تقاس بالنسبة للرأسي والأفقي لا بالتخمين.
methods.principle_en: Choose one unit (often the head) and measure everything with it; drop imaginary vertical and horizontal lines to see what aligns with what, and read angles against true vertical and horizontal.
steps: Set the unit and mark the top and bottom of the subject
Place landmarks by unit counts
Check alignments with vertical and horizontal plumb lines
Correct before rendering
Lock the arm, keep the pencil parallel to the picture plane, close one eye
Read angles like clock hands and drop plumb lines from key landmarks
Use trapped (negative) shapes and the head as units to cross-check lengths
methods.code_recipe: Store a 'unit' in the SVG metadata, place landmarks at unit multiples, and draw plumb lines on the guide layer; the checker reads the unit back.
checks: Landmarks fall within 0.1 unit of the planned positions
Key alignments (eye–ear, knee–elbow) are true
Key landmarks stack as observed on plumb lines
common_errors: Changing the unit mid-drawing
Rendering before landmarks are checked

methods.name_en: Build from simple forms
methods.principle_ar: كل شيء معقد هو تجميع لكرات وعلب وأسطوانات ومخاريط؛ ارسم خطوط الإنشاء خفيفة أولًا، ثم الكتل، ثم الحافة النهائية، ثم احذف المساعدات.
methods.principle_en: Every complex object is an assembly of spheres, boxes, cylinders and cones; lay light construction first, then masses, then the final edge, then remove the helpers.
steps: Name the primitive of each part
Place primitives lightly with correct overlap
Carve the outline over the masses
Hide the construction layer
methods.code_recipe: Emit stage groups guide → mass → outline → detail (as creative_principles.py construct does); each later stage may only refine, never relocate, an earlier primitive.
checks: Every part maps to a named primitive
Final outline stays inside the mass envelope
common_errors: Outlining before masses are placed
Flat circles instead of spheres

methods.name_en: Forms in space: boxes, ellipses and cross-contours
methods.name_ar: الأشكال في الفراغ: العلب والقطوع والخطوط العرضية
methods.principle_ar: الشكل يصير ثلاثي الأبعاد حين تحدده علبة في منظور وقطوع ناقصة تتسع كلما ابتعدت عن مستوى العين، وخطوط عرضية تلتف حول السطح فتبين انحناءه.
methods.principle_en: A form reads as 3D when it sits in a box in perspective, its ellipses open wider the further they are from eye level, and cross-contour lines wrap the surface to show curvature.
steps: Box the object
Set the eye level
Draw ellipses whose minor axis follows the form's axis
Wrap cross-contours to describe the surface
Count the form's vertices, edges and planes; add variables only when detail needs them
Leave a small gap in a line where it passes behind a nearer form
Ellipses close toward eye level and their ends are always round, never pointed
methods.code_recipe: Compute ellipse ry = rx * |sin(tilt)| from the angle to eye level; draw cross-contours as arcs of those ellipses on the construction layer.
checks: Ellipses widen away from eye level
Ellipse minor axis aligns with the cylinder axis
common_errors: Pointed ellipse ends
Same ellipse width at every height

methods.name_en: One, two and three point perspective
methods.principle_ar: خط الأفق هو مستوى عين المشاهد؛ الخطوط المتوازية في الواقع تلتقي في نقطة تلاشٍ واحدة، وارتفاع الأفق ومكان النقاط يقرران إحساس اللقطة (عظمة من أسفل، هشاشة من أعلى).
methods.principle_en: The horizon is the viewer's eye level; parallel edges converge to one vanishing point, and horizon height and point spacing set the mood (heroic from below, vulnerable from above).
steps: Pick camera height and place the horizon
Place vanishing points wide enough to avoid distortion
Block the scene with boxes
Scale figures with the horizon line through the same body point
methods.code_recipe: Use perspective_color_lab.py perspective for exact two-point boxes; place figures so the horizon crosses them at the same height when they stand on the same ground.
checks: Receding edges are collinear with their vanishing point
Standing figures on one ground share the horizon crossing
common_errors: Vanishing points too close (warped boxes)
Figures not scaled to the horizon

methods.name_en: Gesture and line of action
methods.principle_ar: ابدأ بخط واحد منحنٍ يلخص الفعل كله من الرأس للقدم الحاملة، ثم وزّع الكتل عليه؛ قابل المنحنى بمنحنى معاكس (خط مستقيم مقابل منحنى) فيصير الجسم حيًا لا متصلبًا.
methods.principle_en: Start with one curved line that sums up the whole action from head to the weight-bearing foot, then hang masses on it; oppose curve with straight so the body feels alive rather than stiff.
steps: Find the action in 2–5 seconds
Draw the line of action as a C or S curve
Hang head, rib cage and pelvis on it with their tilts
Add limbs as directional lines, straight against curve
methods.code_recipe: Model the line of action as a quadratic or cubic Bezier; place head, rib cage and pelvis at t=0, 0.25, 0.5 with tilts from the curve tangent (drawing_methods.py draw figure does this).
checks: One clear line of action reads at thumbnail size
Rib cage and pelvis tilt in opposition when weight shifts
common_errors: Symmetric stiff pose
Copying contours before the action is caught

methods.name_en: Proportion canons in head units
methods.principle_ar: قِس الجسم برؤوس: البطل المثالي نحو 8 رؤوس، الواقعي 7.5، الطفل 4–5، والشخصيات الكرتونية 2–4؛ منتصف الجسم عند الحوض، والركبة عند الربع السفلي تقريبًا، والذراع المرتخية تصل منتصف الفخذ.
methods.principle_en: Measure the body in heads: idealised hero about 8, realistic adult 7.5, child 4–5, cartoon 2–4; the midpoint sits at the pelvis, the knee near the lower quarter, and the relaxed arm reaches mid-thigh.
steps: Choose the canon from age and style
Mark head units down the figure
Place pelvis at the midpoint, nipples at 2, navel near 3, knees near 6 (8-head canon)
Adjust for character exaggeration on purpose, not by accident
Note the type: about 7.5 heads average, 8 ideal, 9 heroic; women about half a head shorter
Anime adult about 6.5 heads: crotch at half height, waist at elbow level, waist width about one head
methods.code_recipe: drawing_methods.py draw figure --heads N marks every head unit on the guide layer and stores heads_tall in data attributes for the checker.
checks: Total height divided by head height equals the chosen canon within 0.2
Pelvis within 0.25 head of the midpoint
common_errors: Short legs from drawing top-down without measuring
Head drifting larger as detail is added

methods.name_en: Mannequin and bean: rib cage, pelvis, joints
methods.name_ar: المانيكان وحبة الفاصوليا: القفص والحوض والمفاصل
methods.principle_ar: اختزل الجذع إلى كتلتين صلبتين (القفص الصدري والحوض) يربطهما وسط مرن ينضغط ويتمدد كحبة فاصوليا، والأطراف أسطوانات مستدقة بين مفاصل كروية؛ الكتل تتداخل وتتعاشق ولا تتجاور فقط.
methods.principle_en: Reduce the torso to two rigid masses (rib cage and pelvis) joined by a flexible middle that squashes and stretches like a bean; limbs are tapered cylinders between ball joints, and masses overlap and wedge rather than just touch.
steps: Rib cage as an egg, pelvis as a box or bowl
Twist and bend the bean between them
Ball joints at shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, ankle
Tapered limb cylinders with overlaps where they turn toward the viewer
Keep the rib cage a rigid box; bending happens in the abdomen, which bulges or sucks in
Shoulder blades rise and slide with the arms; the trapezius rounds out when they lift
methods.code_recipe: Rib cage and pelvis as rotated ellipses, the bean as a path between them, joints as circles; limb segments as quads tapering from proximal to distal width.
checks: Rib cage and pelvis have independent tilt
Each limb tapers toward the extremity
Rib cage and pelvis keep their size while the waist bends
common_errors: Tube torso with no rib-cage/pelvis separation
Limbs of constant width

methods.name_en: Ball-and-plane head construction
methods.principle_ar: الجمجمة كرة يُقطع جانباها مستويين مسطحين، ويُعلَّق تحتها الفك؛ خط منتصف رأسي وخط الحاجب يلتفّان حول الكرة مع دوران الرأس، والوجه يُقسم إلى ثلاثة أجزاء متساوية تقريبًا: منبت الشعر للحاجب، الحاجب لقاعدة الأنف، الأنف للذقن.
methods.principle_en: The cranium is a ball with its sides sliced flat; the jaw hangs below it. A vertical centre line and a brow line wrap around the ball as the head turns, and the face splits into roughly equal thirds: hairline to brow, brow to nose base, nose to chin.
steps: Draw the ball and the side-plane ellipse
Wrap the centre line and brow line to show yaw and pitch
Drop the face thirds and hang the jaw
Place eyes on a line halfway down the full head, ears between brow and nose base
Treat the mouth as wrapping the cylinder of the teeth, not a flat line
Ear sits between the brow line and the nose line; hairline sets the tilt
methods.code_recipe: drawing_methods.py draw head --yaw D --pitch D rotates the centre line as a vertical ellipse and the brow line as a horizontal ellipse on the ball, then places thirds and features.
prompt_terms: Loomis-style construction (as a teaching method only)
checks: Face thirds equal within 10%
Eyes on the half-height line of the full head
Ear sits between brow and nose base lines
common_errors: Eyes too high on the head
Centre line not curving with the turn

methods.name_en: Hands as blocks and arcs
methods.principle_ar: كف اليد علبة مسطحة مائلة الحافة، والإبهام كتلة منفصلة لها قاعدة كبيرة، ومفاصل الأصابع تقع على أقواس لا على خط مستقيم؛ ارسم اتجاه الإيماءة أولًا ثم أطوال الأصابع.
methods.principle_en: The palm is a flat box with a slanted knuckle edge, the thumb a separate mass with a big base, and finger joints sit on arcs, not straight lines; draw the gesture of the hand before the finger lengths.
steps: Box the palm and set its tilt
Arc the knuckle lines
Attach the thumb mass at the wrist side
Taper fingers in three segments
Palm block with cut corners; thumb as two segments plus a wedge
Foot from the side is about three squares long and one high; the big toe moves most
methods.code_recipe: Palm as a skewed quad, knuckle arcs as concentric arcs from a point near the wrist, fingers as three-segment chains (reuse two-bone IK from character_ik.py for the poses).
checks: Five digits with three visible segments each (thumb two)
Knuckles follow an arc
common_errors: Sausage fingers of equal length
Thumb growing from the palm's middle

methods.name_en: Drapery and fold types
methods.principle_ar: القماش يتدلى من نقاط ارتكاز (كتف، كوع، ركبة) وينضغط أو يلتف حولها؛ صنّف كل طية (أنبوبية، حلزونية، نصف قفل، متعرجة، متساقطة) وارسمها كاستجابة للشد والجاذبية لا كخطوط عشوائية.
methods.principle_en: Cloth hangs from support points (shoulder, elbow, knee) and compresses or spirals around them; classify each fold (pipe, spiral, half-lock, zigzag, drop) and draw it as a response to tension and gravity, not random lines.
steps: Mark support points
Draw tension lines between them
Choose fold types where cloth compresses
Keep the body form readable under the cloth
Name each wrinkle type: gravity, gathered, pulled (between two points), diamond, tuck
Use an island shadow (a floating shadow shape) instead of drawing every crease line
Learn the basic fold set (pipe, diaper — cloth hung from two points — and the rest) before free drapery
methods.code_recipe: Generate fold strokes radiating from support points along tension vectors; hide folds that would cross the silhouette of the body mass.
checks: Every fold traces back to a support point or compression zone
Body volume still reads
Every fold starts at a joint, a contact point or a gathering point
common_errors: Uniform parallel wrinkles
Folds that ignore gravity

methods.name_en: Balance, weight and contrapposto
methods.principle_ar: خط الجاذبية من عظمة الرقبة يسقط على القدم الحاملة للوزن؛ حين يحمل الوزن ساق واحدة يرتفع حوضها وينخفض الكتف المقابل، فتتعاكس زاويتا الكتفين والحوض.
methods.principle_en: The gravity line from the pit of the neck falls on the weight-bearing foot; when one leg takes the weight its hip rises and the opposite shoulder drops, so shoulder and hip lines tilt against each other.
steps: Drop the gravity line
Put the weight foot under it
Tilt pelvis up on the weight side
Counter-tilt the shoulders
Break a static stance: weight on one leg, turn the torso, tilt the head or lean on support
methods.code_recipe: In draw figure --pose contrapposto the support foot x equals the neck x; pelvis and shoulder angles are set with opposite signs.
checks: Neck point within 0.3 head of the support foot horizontally
Shoulder and hip tilt with opposite signs
common_errors: Figure falling over (gravity line outside the base)
Parallel shoulder and hip lines in a weight shift

methods.name_en: Shape language
methods.principle_ar: الشكل الأساسي يقول الشخصية قبل الكلام: الدائرة لطف وأمان ومرح، المربع ثبات وقوة وعناد، المثلث خطر وذكاء وحركة؛ ولكل شخصية شكل غالب وشكل ثانوي، مع تنويع الأحجام (كبير/متوسط/صغير) لا تكرار حجم واحد.
methods.principle_en: The base shape speaks before dialogue: circle reads friendly, safe and playful; square reads stable, strong, stubborn; triangle reads dangerous, clever, dynamic. Give each character one dominant and one secondary shape, and vary size (big, medium, small) instead of repeating one size.
steps: Write the personality in three words
Pick the dominant shape that carries it
Add a contrasting secondary shape for interest
Distribute big/medium/small masses
methods.code_recipe: drawing_methods.py draw character --shape circle|square|triangle builds the body, head and limbs from that primitive and records the dominant shape in metadata.
checks: The dominant shape is identifiable in the silhouette
At least two clearly different mass sizes
common_errors: All parts the same size
Shape contradicting the stated personality

methods.name_en: Silhouette readability
methods.principle_ar: املأ الرسم بالأسود: إن لم تُفهم الشخصية ووضعيتها من الظل وحده فالتصميم ضعيف؛ أبعد الأطراف عن الجذع في الوضعيات المهمة، وأعطِ كل شخصية في المجموعة سيلويت مختلفًا.
methods.principle_en: Fill the drawing black: if the character and pose do not read from the silhouette alone, the design is weak. Pull limbs away from the torso in key poses and give each member of a cast a distinct silhouette.
steps: Render a solid-black version
Look at it at thumbnail size
Open up overlapping limbs
Compare cast silhouettes side by side
Stage one idea at a time; keep hands off the face so the silhouette reads
methods.code_recipe: Every draw command also emits a 'silhouette' layer (same shapes, solid fill) as a small inset thumbnail, so the pose is judged at thumbnail size; drawing_methods.py check confirms the layer exists.
checks: Pose reads at 64 px tall
Two cast members' silhouettes differ in outline
common_errors: Arms hidden in front of the body
All cast members the same height and shape

methods.name_en: Exaggeration, appeal and age by proportion
methods.principle_ar: الجاذبية تأتي من وضوح وتبسيط ومبالغة مقصودة: رأس أكبر وعينان أوسع وأدنى في الوجه تعطي صغرًا وبراءة، ووجه أطول وعينان أصغر وأعلى تعطي نضجًا؛ بالغ في السمة التي تحمل الشخصية لا في كل شيء.
methods.principle_en: Appeal comes from clarity, simplification and deliberate exaggeration: a larger head and bigger, lower-set eyes read young and innocent; a longer face and smaller, higher eyes read mature. Exaggerate the trait that carries the character, not everything.
steps: Pick the age and the one defining trait
Set head-to-body ratio and eye placement from the age
Push the defining trait 20–50%
Simplify everything else
Exaggerate as a caricature of reality: sadder, brighter, wilder, never distorted for its own sake
methods.code_recipe: draw character --age child|teen|adult|elder sets heads-tall (3/4.5/6/5.5 in cartoon scale) and eye line height on the face.
checks: Head ratio matches the stated age
Exactly one or two exaggerated traits
common_errors: Exaggerating every feature equally
Adult proportions on a child character

methods.name_en: Facial expression from brows, eyes and mouth
methods.principle_ar: أغلب التعبير في ثلاث أدوات: زاوية الحاجبين، انفتاح الجفنين، وشكل الفم؛ الفرح يرفع الوجنتين ويضيّق العين، الحزن يرفع الطرف الداخلي للحاجب، الغضب يخفضه ويضغط الشفتين، والدهشة ترفع الحاجبين وتفتح الفم.
methods.principle_en: Most expression comes from three tools: brow angle, eyelid opening and mouth shape. Joy lifts the cheeks and narrows the eyes, sadness lifts the inner brow, anger lowers it and presses the lips, surprise raises the brows and opens the mouth.
steps: Choose the emotion and its intensity
Set brow angles
Set lid opening
Shape the mouth; let the cheeks follow
Show the change of expression, not only the end state; one eye slightly wider adds life
Cheeks keep their volume when the eye squints
methods.code_recipe: draw character --expression happy|sad|angry|surprised|neutral sets brow rotation, lid height and mouth curve from one table.
checks: Brows, lids and mouth agree on one emotion
Expression reads at thumbnail size
common_errors: Smiling mouth with angry brows by accident
Expression only in the mouth

methods.name_en: Cartoon construction with squash and stretch
methods.principle_ar: الشخصية الكرتونية تُبنى من كرات وكمثريات مرنة تحفظ حجمها: إن انضغطت عرضت وإن تمددت نحفت؛ ثبّت الحجم تقريبًا في كل إطار ليبقى الجسم مقنعًا.
methods.principle_en: Cartoon characters are built from soft balls and pears that keep their volume: squash widens, stretch thins. Keep the area roughly constant across frames so the body stays believable.
steps: Construct with soft primitives
Pick the squash or stretch factor
Scale the other axis by its inverse
Check area is preserved
Test with the flour-sack: the attitude must read with no interior lines
methods.code_recipe: Apply scale(sx, 1/sx) around the contact point; the checker compares ellipse areas between keyframes.
checks: Area change under 10% between squash and stretch frames
common_errors: Growing or shrinking volume
Rigid shapes in a cartoon style

methods.name_en: Turnarounds and model sheets
methods.principle_ar: لتثبت الشخصية في كل لقطة ارسمها من الأمام وثلاثة أرباع والجانب والخلف على خطوط أفقية مشتركة (أعلى الرأس، العين، الذقن، الكتف، الحوض، الركبة، القدم)، ودوّن الألوان والنسب.
methods.principle_en: To keep a character consistent across shots, draw it front, three-quarter, side and back on shared horizontal guides (top of head, eyes, chin, shoulders, pelvis, knees, feet) and note colours and proportions.
steps: Fix the guide heights from the front view
Project each view across the guides
Lock the palette as hex values
Use the sheet as the reference for every later image or prompt
methods.code_recipe: Render the same character spec with yaw 0/45/90/180 side by side and draw the shared guide lines across all views.
checks: Landmarks align on the shared guides in every view
Palette identical across views
common_errors: Height drifting between views
Costume details changing between angles

methods.name_en: Light family and shadow family
methods.principle_ar: افصل الضوء عن الظل أولًا بحد واضح (خط الانتهاء)، ثم قسّم: إضاءة عالية، نصف ضوء، خط انتهاء، ظل ذاتي، ضوء منعكس خافت، ظل ملقى أغمق عند نقطة التلامس؛ لا تجعل الضوء المنعكس أفتح من أي جزء مضاء.
methods.principle_en: Separate light from shadow first with a clear terminator, then subdivide: highlight, half-tone, terminator, form shadow, faint reflected light, and a cast shadow darkest at the contact point. Reflected light never gets brighter than any lit area.
steps: Place the light source
Draw the terminator on each form
Fill shadow as one value
Add half-tones, highlight and occlusion at contacts
Order the planes: light, halftone, shadow (where the plane runs parallel to the light), reflected light, cast shadow
Nothing in the shadow family may be as light as anything in the light family
Map light and shadow as territories with definite borders; contrast is greatest where the form turns
The cast shadow carries the darkest dark where it meets the object and a sharper edge than the form shadow
methods.code_recipe: Shade spheres and cylinders with a two-stop split at the terminator angle plus a radial gradient; cast shadows as skewed ellipses away from the light vector.
prompt_terms: soft key light from upper left
checks: One consistent light direction
Every shadow value darker than every light value
Reflected light stays darker than the darkest halftone
common_errors: Shadows on different sides of different objects
Bright reflected light breaking the form

methods.name_en: Value grouping and notan
methods.principle_ar: صمّم الصورة بثلاث قيم أو أربع فقط (فاتح، متوسط، داكن) في كتل كبيرة متصلة قبل اللون؛ أقوى تباين يوضع عند نقطة التركيز.
methods.principle_en: Design the picture with only three or four values (light, mid, dark) in large connected masses before any colour; put the strongest contrast at the focal point.
steps: Squint and merge small values
Build a 3-value thumbnail
Place maximum contrast at the focus
Keep that value plan through colour
Reduce a photo to 3–5 flat greys before rendering, and check it from a distance
methods.code_recipe: creative_principles.py values reduces a greyscale study to three values; compare the plan's dark ratio with the final.
checks: The image reads in three values
Highest contrast sits at the focal point
common_errors: Evenly spotted values with no masses
Focal point in a low-contrast area

methods.name_en: Colour temperature and limited palettes
methods.principle_ar: اللون نسبي: نفس اللون يتغير بجيرانه؛ إن كان الضوء دافئًا فالظل يميل للبرودة والعكس، واختر لوحة محدودة (لون غالب + مكمّل صغير + محايدات) بدل كل الألوان.
methods.principle_en: Colour is relative: the same colour shifts with its neighbours. A warm light gives cool shadows and vice versa; choose a limited palette (dominant hue, a small complement, neutrals) rather than every hue.
steps: Decide light temperature
Shift shadows the opposite way
Pick dominant/accent/neutral roles
Check value still works in greyscale
Split the palette roughly 70 / 25 / 5 between main, secondary and accent colours
Light colour tints the whole lit side; the halftone holds the most saturation
methods.code_recipe: Derive shadow hex by rotating hue toward blue (or orange) and lowering value; validate contrast with perspective_color_lab.py palette.
checks: Light and shadow temperatures differ
At most one accent hue
common_errors: Shadows made by adding black only
Rainbow palette without hierarchy

methods.name_en: Thumbnails, framing and focal path
methods.principle_ar: قبل الرسم الكبير ارسم مصغرات سريعة تجرب الكادر والزاوية ومكان البطل؛ قُد العين بخطوط وتباين واتجاه نظرات نحو نقطة تركيز واحدة، واترك فراغًا للتنفس.
methods.principle_en: Before the big drawing, make quick thumbnails that test the frame, angle and hero placement; lead the eye with lines, contrast and gaze direction toward one focal point, and leave breathing space.
steps: Make 3–6 thumbnails
Pick the clearest one
Place the focal point off-centre (thirds or golden ratio)
Route leading lines and gazes to it
Give the focal area the highest value and saturation contrast and the most detail
methods.code_recipe: Generate thumbnails as small SVG frames with grey blocks; score focal point distance to the thirds intersections.
checks: One focal point
Leading lines converge on it
common_errors: Centred static composition by default
Competing focal points

methods.name_en: How shapes carry emotion
methods.principle_ar: الأفقي هدوء، الرأسي قوة، المائل حركة وتوتر، الحاد خوف، المستدير أمان؛ الأشكال الأعلى في الكادر تبدو أقوى، والأكبر أهم، والتباين يجذب الانتباه.
methods.principle_en: Horizontals feel calm, verticals strong, diagonals active and tense, points threatening, curves safe; shapes higher in the frame feel more powerful, bigger feels more important, and contrast pulls attention.
steps: Name the target emotion
Choose dominant line direction
Set sizes and heights by importance
Use contrast only where attention belongs
methods.code_recipe: Map emotion to line angle and corner radius tables; apply them to background shapes in the SVG.
checks: Dominant direction matches the emotion
Most important element is the largest or highest-contrast
common_errors: Diagonal chaos in a calm scene

methods.name_en: Line weight and inking
methods.principle_ar: الخط الأسمك للخارج والقريب ومناطق الظل ونقاط الارتكاز، والأنحف للداخل والبعيد والجهة المضاءة؛ الخط يبدأ ويختم برقة (تستدق النهايات)، والتهشير يتبع اتجاه السطح.
methods.principle_en: Heavier lines for the outer silhouette, near forms, shadow sides and contact points; thinner for interior, far and lit edges. Strokes taper at both ends and hatching follows the surface direction.
steps: Set three line weights
Assign silhouette = heavy, interior = light
Thicken on the shadow side
Taper stroke ends
Silhouette and overlapping contours heaviest, inner lines thinner; lighten lines next to light areas
methods.code_recipe: Assign stroke-width per layer (silhouette 3x, interior 1x); for tapered strokes use creative_paint.py pressure brush strokes.
checks: At least two distinct line weights
Silhouette heavier than interior lines
common_errors: One uniform line weight everywhere
Hairy, restated strokes

methods.name_en: Animal construction from the skeleton line
methods.principle_ar: ابدأ الحيوان بخط العمود الفقري وكتلتي الصدر والحوض، ثم الأرجل كزوايا (الحيوان يمشي على أصابعه غالبًا فالكعب مرتفع)، والرأس كتلة جمجمة وخطم؛ الإيماءة قبل الفراء.
methods.principle_en: Start an animal with the spine line and the chest and hip masses, then legs as angled segments (most mammals walk on their toes, so the heel sits high), and the head as cranium plus muzzle; gesture before fur.
steps: Spine curve
Chest and hip masses
Zig-zag legs with high heels
Cranium and muzzle, then ears and tail
Fit the whole animal under one big arc of the spine
Even rounded animals have angular masses (a horse's rump is a box, not a ball)
Coat strokes follow the fur direction from head to tail
methods.code_recipe: Reuse the figure pipeline with a horizontal line of action, two ellipses for chest/hips and three-segment legs; code_drawing_master.py already draws a procedural cat.
checks: Back leg shows the raised heel (hock)
Chest mass larger than hip mass for most quadrupeds
Head-to-body ratio kept in every pose
common_errors: Human-like knees on hind legs
Fur detail before the gesture

methods.name_en: Panels, closure and visual storytelling
methods.principle_ar: القارئ يكمل ما بين اللوحات بعقله؛ اختر الانتقال (لحظة للحظة، فعل لفعل، موضوع لموضوع، مشهد لمشهد) حسب الإيقاع، وحافظ على خط المحور واتجاه النظرات لتبقى الجغرافيا واضحة.
methods.principle_en: Readers fill the gap between panels themselves; choose the transition type (moment, action, subject, scene) for the rhythm, and keep the 180° axis and gaze directions so the geography stays clear.
steps: Beat the story into moments
Pick the transition type per beat
Keep screen direction consistent
Vary shot size for rhythm
Stage drama with strong foreground angles; stage comedy flat, symmetrical and clear
Go from script to thumbnail panels before any finished drawing
The setup line carries the joke: keep balloons to about 18 words and hold the camera angle until the punch line
methods.code_recipe: Plan panels as JSON (shot size, angle, transition) and feed them to storyboard/motion tools; check screen direction per character across panels.
checks: Screen direction preserved unless a cut deliberately crosses the axis
Shot sizes vary
common_errors: Every panel the same shot size
Characters swapping sides between panels

methods.name_en: Squash, stretch, anticipation and follow-through
methods.principle_ar: أي شكل حي يتصرف ككيس دقيق نصف ممتلئ: ينضغط ويتمدد ويحتفظ بحجمه دائمًا. قبل كل فعل كبير حركة صغيرة عكسه (تحضير) تُعلن ما سيحدث، وبعده تكمل الأطراف والشعر والقماش حركتها وتتوقف أجزاء الجسم في أوقات مختلفة؛ والوقفة لا تموت بل تنجرف ببطء نحو نسخة أقوى منها.
methods.principle_en: Every living shape behaves like a half-filled flour sack: it squashes and stretches but keeps its volume. Before each big action comes a small move the opposite way (anticipation) that tells the viewer what is coming; afterwards the appendages, hair and cloth keep going and body parts settle at different times; a held pose never freezes but drifts into a stronger version of itself (moving hold).
steps: Draw the key pose, then the anticipation pose leaning the opposite way
Stretch along the path of fast motion, squash on impact, keep the area constant
Let loose parts (hair, ears, tail, cloth) arrive later than the body and overshoot
Stop the head and chest first, the appendages last
On a hold, keep a few frames of drift toward a stronger version of the pose
Break joints in succession: the wrist leads and the fingertips drag, and big body moves start in the hips
methods.code_recipe: Scale each drawing along the motion direction by k and across it by 1/k so rx*ry stays constant; delay secondary parts by 2-4 frames behind the main mass. `drawing_methods.py draw bounce` demonstrates the volume rule and checks it.
checks: Volume (area) constant within 3% across squash and stretch
Anticipation moves opposite to the main action
Secondary parts lag the main mass and settle last
common_errors: Squash that shrinks the shape (volume lost)
Action without anticipation reads as a teleport
Everything stops on the same frame (dead, mechanical)

methods.name_en: Timing, spacing, slow in/out and arcs
methods.principle_ar: التوقيت هو عدد الرسوم بين وضعيتين، والتباعد هو المسافة بين كل رسمة والتالية. رسوم متقاربة عند البداية والنهاية تعطي بطئًا طبيعيًا، ومتباعدة في الوسط تعطي سرعة. الكائن الحي يتحرك على أقواس لا خطوط مستقيمة، والعمل على «اثنين» (كل رسمة لإطارين) كافٍ لمعظم الحركة بينما «واحد» للحركات السريعة وتحريك الكاميرا.
methods.principle_en: Timing is how many drawings sit between two poses; spacing is how far apart each drawing is from the next. Drawings bunched near the extremes and spread in the middle read as natural easing; even spacing reads as a machine. Living things travel on arcs, not straight lines. Shooting on twos covers most action; ones are for fast accents, pans and camera moves.
steps: Pick the extremes (keys) and decide the frame count between them
Draw a spacing chart: ticks bunched toward the slow end
Plot the path of action as an arc through the keys
Use few inbetweens for a hit, many for a deliberate or lazy move
Lead dialogue accents by about two to three frames
Place the breakdown (passing) drawing first: it decides the arc and the character of the move
methods.code_recipe: Position_i = ease(i/n) along an arc; for gravity use height = H(1 - t^2) per frame. The bounce demo checks that spacing near the apex is smaller than near contact.
prompt_terms: clear path of action on an arc
checks: Spacing chart is uneven where motion speeds up or slows down
Path of action is an arc, not a straight line
Frame count matches the intended weight and mood
common_errors: Inbetweening lines instead of volumes so features slide around the head
Even spacing everywhere (robotic)
Straight-line inbetweens that flatten an arc
Holding the contact frame too long so the object hops

methods.name_en: Tipped line of balance and sweep
methods.principle_ar: في أي حركة إلى الأمام يسبق أعلى الجسم قاعدته كعصا تحاول موازنتها على كفّك: خط التوازن يميل في اتجاه الحركة، والقدم الدافعة خلفه، والكعب لا يقع أبدًا تحت الرأس. الوقفة الجيدة تحمل أثر الحركة التي سبقتها (الاندفاع)، ومن يدفع شيئًا بقوة ينحني خط توازنه كالزنبرك. الرأس بين القدمين يعني ثباتًا، وخارجهما يعني حركة.
methods.principle_en: In any forward movement the top of the body leads the base, like a pole balanced on your palm: the line of balance tips toward the motion, the pushing foot stays behind it and a heel never sits right under the head. A good action pose still carries the movement that came before it (sweep); a figure pushing hard bends its balance line like a spring. Head between the feet reads as stable; head outside the base reads as motion.
steps: Draw the balance line tipped in the direction of travel
Place the head ahead of the supporting foot
Put the pushing foot behind the line
Add one hint of the previous movement (trailing arm, hair, cloth)
Compensate any lean with a limb on the opposite side when the figure must stay balanced
methods.code_recipe: For a running or walking pose set the line from support foot to head at 5-20 degrees off vertical toward the motion; the head x must lie ahead of the support-foot x.
checks: Head is ahead of the support foot in forward motion
Pushing foot lies behind the balance line
Static poses keep the head between the feet
common_errors: Upright runner who looks like he is standing
Heel directly under the head in a stride
Lean with no counterweight in a static pose

methods.name_en: Draw verbs: tension, straight against curve, angles
methods.name_ar: ارسم الفعل لا الاسم: الشد والمستقيم مقابل المنحنى والزوايا
methods.principle_ar: سمِّ الفعل قبل أن ترسم (ينحني، يشد، يدفع) وارسم القصة لا التشريح. الجانب المشدود من الجسم خط مستقيم والجانب المنضغط منحنٍ؛ كل الخطوط منحنية تعني رسمة رخوة. تخيّل شريطًا مطاطيًا بين اليد واليد والقدم والقدم والرأس والقدم وارسم الشد بينها. ضع زاوية مقابل زاوية (الكتفان ضد الحوض، الرأس ضد الكتفين) وشدّة الزاوية تتبع شدة الشعور.
methods.principle_en: Name the verb before drawing (bending, pulling, pushing) and draw the story, not the anatomy. The stretched side of the body is a straight line and the pinched side a curve; all curves make a limp drawing. Imagine a rubber band between hand and hand, foot and foot, head and foot, and draw the tension between parts rather than the parts. Set angle against angle (shoulders against hips, head against shoulders); the steeper the angle, the stronger the feeling.
steps: Write or say the action verb
Find the stretched side (straight) and the squashed side (curve)
Relate every hand, elbow, knee and foot to its opposite
Tilt shoulders and hips against each other
Discard 90% of detail; keep the 10% that tells the action
Before each sketch ask what the pose is for and what the viewer should feel
methods.code_recipe: Represent each limb pair as a constraint; tag contours as 'stretch' (straight) or 'squash' (curved) and make sure both appear in the figure's outline.
checks: One side of the torso straight, the other curved
Shoulder and hip lines are not parallel in an action pose
No twins: paired limbs do different things
common_errors: Symmetric twin limbs
Drawing anatomy details before the action reads
Lazy lines that describe nothing

methods.name_en: Horizon rule for placing figures in depth
methods.name_ar: قاعدة الأفق لوضع الأشخاص في العمق
methods.principle_ar: على أرض مستوية يقطع خط الأفق كل الأشخاص المتماثلين عند النقطة نفسها من أجسامهم أينما وقفوا: إذا كانت العين على ارتفاع رأس واقف فكل الرؤوس على الأفق. ارسم شخصًا مرجعيًا ثم انقل ارتفاعه إلى أي عمق بخطين إلى نقطة على الأفق. تصلح القاعدة للخيل والكراسي والسيارات.
methods.principle_en: On level ground the horizon crosses every figure of the same size at the same point of the body, wherever they stand: with the eye at a standing person's head height every head sits on the horizon. Draw one key figure, then carry its height to any depth with two lines meeting at a point on the horizon. The rule works for horses, chairs and cars too.
steps: Draw the horizon at the viewer's eye height
Draw a key figure and note where the horizon cuts it
Pick a new foot position; run lines from the key figure's head and feet to a point on the horizon
Transfer the height across with horizontals
Cut every similar figure at the same body point
methods.code_recipe: Given horizon y_h, key figure feet y_f and height H: a figure with feet at y has height H*(y - y_h)/(y_f - y_h).
checks: All standing adults are cut by the horizon at the same body point
Sizes shrink toward the horizon, not randomly
common_errors: Background people floating or giant
Viewpoint drawn too high in street scenes

methods.name_en: Cast-shadow construction from a light source
methods.name_ar: بناء الظل الساقط من مصدر ضوء
methods.principle_ar: الظل الساقط يُبنى ولا يُخمَّن. لمصباح قريب: أسقط عمودًا من المصباح إلى الأرض؛ تلك النقطة هي نقطة تلاشي الظلال على الأرض. كل زاوية في الظل تقع حيث يلتقي شعاع من قدم المصباح عبر قاعدة الحافة مع شعاع من المصباح عبر أعلاها. للشمس: الأشعة متوازية، وظلال الحواف تتلاشى إلى نقطة أسفل الشمس على الأفق. الظل أغمق وأحدّ عند نقطة التلامس ويلين كلما ابتعد.
methods.principle_en: A cast shadow is constructed, not guessed. For a near lamp drop a vertical from the lamp to the ground: that foot is the vanishing point of the ground shadows. Each shadow corner lies where a ray from the foot through an edge's base meets a ray from the lamp through the edge's top. For sunlight the rays are parallel and shadow edges converge to the point under the sun on the horizon. The shadow is darkest and sharpest at the contact point and softens as it travels away.
steps: Mark the light and drop its foot to the ground plane
For each vertical edge, ray from the foot through the base
Ray from the light through the top; the crossing is the shadow corner
Join the corners; the object stands on its shadow
Darken and sharpen at contact, soften with distance
methods.code_recipe: `drawing_methods.py draw shadow` builds the shadow by line intersection and `check` verifies every shadow point lies on both rays (offset < 1 px).
checks: Every shadow corner lies on both its light ray and its ground ray
All shadows share one light
Contact shadow is the darkest part
common_errors: Shadows pointing different ways
Floating objects without a contact shadow
Shadow the same length regardless of light height

methods.name_en: Tone from marks: hatching, stipple and grey-to-ink
methods.name_ar: القيمة من العلامات: التظليل الخطي والتنقيط وتحويل الرمادي إلى حبر
methods.principle_ar: في الرصاص والحبر تصنع القيمة من كثافة العلامات: المسافة بين الخطوط وسمكها وعدد الاتجاهات وسرعتها. ابدأ الضربة من الحافة المهمة (حافة الظل الأمامية) واتركها تتلاشى، واجعل الخطوط تلتف مع سطح الشكل. قبل الحبر حوّل المشهد إلى 3–5 درجات رمادية مسطحة، ثم ترجم كل درجة إلى كثافة تهشير أو تنقيط.
methods.principle_en: In pencil and ink value comes from mark density: spacing, thickness, number of directions and speed of the strokes. Start each stroke at the important edge (the leading edge of a shadow) and let it trail off, and let strokes wrap the surface like cross-contours. Before inking, reduce the scene to 3–5 flat greys, then translate each grey into a hatching or stipple density.
steps: Make a 3–5 value breakdown of the subject
Assign one mark density per value
Lay parallel hatching for the first value, cross it for darker
Start strokes at the shadow edge and flick away
Keep the paper white for the lightest value
methods.code_recipe: Map each value band to hatch spacing s = s0 * (1 - v) and add a second direction when v > 0.5; clip hatch groups to the value shape.
checks: No more than 5 distinct densities
Hatching direction follows or wraps the form
Lightest areas left as untouched paper
common_errors: Fuzzy back-and-forth sketchy strokes
Uniform hatching with no value plan
Outlining every shape heavily instead of using tone

methods.name_en: Anime and manga head angles with cross-lines
methods.name_ar: زوايا رأس الأنمي والمانجا بخطوط التقاطع
methods.principle_ar: خطا التقاطع (المحور الرأسي وخط العينين) يقرران تصميم الوجه قبل أي ملامح. في الزاوية المنخفضة ينحني خط العينين لأعلى ويظهر أسفل الفك، وفي العالية ينحني لأسفل ويظهر أعلى الرأس. المسافة بين خط الحاجب وخط العين تحدد حجم العين، والعيون الأدنى تعطي وجهًا أصغر سنًا. ميل محور الرأس على محور الجذع وخط الكتفين يصنع الدراما.
methods.principle_en: The two cross-lines (vertical centre axis and eye line) decide the face's design before any feature. From a low angle the eye line arcs upward and the underside of the jaw shows; from a high angle it arcs downward and the crown shows. The gap between brow line and eye line sets eye size; lower-set eyes read younger. Tilting the head axis against the torso axis and shoulder line creates drama.
steps: Draw the head as a ball or box and choose its turn and tilt
Wrap the centre axis and eye line around it
Set brow and eye lines to choose eye size and age
Place the nose base below the eye line and the mouth on its own line
Check that inner eye corner and nose bridge share a contour in three-quarter view
Eyes sit in a V-shaped indent; the mouth is slightly above halfway from nose base to chin
methods.code_recipe: Use the head demo's yaw/pitch to place the eye-line curve; for anime push the eye line slightly below mid-height and enlarge the brow-to-eye gap.
prompt_terms: anime character head at three-quarter view
checks: Eye line curvature matches the camera angle
Both eyes sit on one wrapped eye line
Far eye narrowed by the nose bridge
common_errors: Front-view features pasted on a turned head
Head too small or too thin for the body
Nose base drawn from the eye line

methods.name_en: Hair as masses that grow and move
methods.principle_ar: الشعر ينمو من الدوامة وخط الفرق ويتبع الجمجمة مع فراغ ثابت فوقها. ارسم الكتلة الخارجية أولًا ثم قسّمها إلى خصلات كبيرة ثم أصغر، وظلّل حيث تتراكب الخصلات فقط. الجاذبية تشد الأطراف لأسفل مهما مال الرأس؛ الريح والجري والقفز والسقوط تغيّر الشكل بقوانين ثابتة، وحالة الشعر تحكي الشعور (متهدّل حزين، مرفوع غاضب أو قوي).
methods.principle_en: Hair grows from the crown whorl and the parting and follows the skull with a constant volume gap. Draw the outer mass first, divide it into big locks, then smaller ones, and shade only where locks overlap. Gravity pulls the ends straight down however the head tilts; wind, running, jumping and falling reshape it by fixed rules, and the hair's state tells the emotion (limp = sad, lifted = anger or power).
steps: Mark crown and parting on the head
Draw the silhouette of the whole hair mass outside the skull
Split into big groups (fringe, sides, back), then locks
Shade only overlaps and the underside of the back mass
Apply the force: gravity, wind direction, motion
methods.code_recipe: Model each lock as a curve rooted on the skull whose tip vector = gravity + wind + inertia; keep roots on a circle offset from the skull by a fixed gap.
prompt_terms: flowing anime hair in the wind
checks: Gap between skull and hair outline is consistent
All loose ends obey one force direction
Locks radiate from crown or parting
common_errors: Strands before the mass
Hair stuck flat to the skull
Wind blowing two ways at once

methods.name_en: Anime skin and cel-shading layer stack
methods.name_ar: طبقات تلوين بشرة الأنمي والتظليل الخلوي
methods.principle_ar: رتّب الطبقات: لون أساسي مسطح، ظل أول بحدود واضحة يتبع الشكل، ظل ثانٍ أغمق في التجاويف، طبقة ضوء محيط باردة، ضوء منعكس على الحواف داخل الظل، ثم لمعات صغيرة، وأخيرًا تلوين الخط نفسه. في البشرة لا تُغمِّق بالأسود: الظل الأول أعلى تشبعًا بنفس السطوع ويميل للأحمر، والثاني أغمق ويميل للبنفسجي. الضوء القوي حدود حادة مع تشبع عند الحد، والضوء الغائم تدرج ناعم.
methods.principle_en: Order the layers: flat base, first shadow with a clean edge that follows the form, a darker second shadow in the recesses, a cool ambient layer, reflected light along edges inside the shadow, small highlights, and finally recolour the line art. For skin never darken with black: the first shadow is more saturated at the same brightness and shifts toward red; the second is darker and shifts toward violet. Hard light gives sharp edges with extra saturation at the border; overcast light gives a soft gradient.
steps: Flat base colours on separate layers
Shadow 1: same value, higher saturation, hue toward red
Shadow 2: darker, hue toward violet, only in deep recesses
Reflected light along the shadow-side contour, never brighter than the lit side
Highlights last; recolour lines (lighter near light, darker in shadow)
Skin shadows get warmer and more saturated toward the terminator (light scattering under the skin)
methods.code_recipe: Shadow1 = HSV(h - 8deg, s + 0.25, v); Shadow2 = HSV(h - 20deg toward magenta, s + 0.15, v - 0.2); multiply-free palette ramps per material.
checks: No grey or black used in skin shadows
Reflected light dimmer than any lit area
One light direction for all shadow edges
common_errors: Muddy grey shadows
Pure black line art on soft skin
Reflected light as bright as the key light

methods.name_en: Urban sketching: setup lines then forced values
methods.name_ar: رسم المدن: خطوط إعداد ثم قيم مضخّمة
methods.principle_ar: خطوتان: أولًا رسم إعداد خفيف يبدأ بنقطة التركيز ثم خط الأفق وخطين متقاربين يحددان نقاط التلاشي، ثم الرأسيات، وشبكات النوافذ بخطوط إرشاد طويلة لا نافذة نافذة. ثانيًا القيم: ارسم الظلال واحفظ الأضواء، و«ضخّم الظلال» بأعلى تباين عند حافتها الأمامية مع ضوء منعكس أخف في عمقها. الأشخاص رؤوسهم على الأفق، والسيارات صناديق بسيطة، والأشجار بأنماط تهشير متنوعة.
methods.principle_en: Two steps. First a light setup sketch: focal point, horizon, two converging lines that fix the vanishing points, verticals, and window grids from long guidelines across many windows rather than window by window. Second the values: draw the darks and reserve the lights, and force the shadows: highest contrast at the shadow's leading edge, lighter reflected light deeper inside. People's heads go on the horizon, cars are simple boxes, trees are varied hatch patterns.
steps: Stand, sight the focal point and the horizon
Two converging lines -> vanishing points; then verticals
Long guidelines for repeated windows and floors
Block the shadow shapes; darkest at the light/shadow border
Add entourage: heads on the horizon, box cars, varied trees
methods.code_recipe: Generate facade grids by dividing two edges toward one VP; shade planes facing away from the sun at value 0.7 with a darker 0.85 strip along the leading edge.
prompt_terms: urban sketch in pen and wash
checks: All facade lines reach their vanishing points
Shadow sides share one sun direction
Entourage heads align with the horizon
common_errors: Fuzzy back-and-forth lines
Drawing every window instead of guidelines
Subject entirely in shade goes muddy

methods.name_en: Flowers, leaves and trees from simple shapes
methods.name_ar: الزهور والأوراق والأشجار من أشكال بسيطة
methods.principle_ar: كل زهرة أو وردة تبدأ بأشكال بسيطة (دوائر، بيضاوي، أقواس، قطرات، قلوب) ثم تُحدَّد البتلات بحواف مموجة أو مسننة. البتلة الملتوية تظهر بخط ثانٍ داخل الأول، والورقة المطوية بحافة ناعمة خارج حافة متموجة، والسمك بخط موازٍ. التظليل يتبع السطح: خطوط قصيرة قرب العروق وأطراف البتلات، وطويلة منحنية بمحاذاة جوانب الورقة. الشجرة جذع وكتلة أوراق، والفروع تتفرع كحروف Y وV.
methods.principle_en: Every flower starts as simple shapes (circles, ovals, arcs, teardrops, hearts), then petals get scalloped or jagged edges. A curled petal shows as a second line inside the first, a folded leaf as a smooth edge outside a wavy one, thickness as a parallel line. Shading follows the surface: short strokes near veins and petal tips, long curves along leaf sides. A tree is a trunk plus a foliage mass, branches split like Y and V.
steps: Block the flower head and stem with simple shapes
Cut petal edges; add turned edges and folds
Draw veins as branching double lines
Shade undersides and the side of each stem
For trees: mass first, then Y-shaped branching, then texture by mark type
methods.code_recipe: Petals as rotated teardrop paths around a centre; a second inset offset path marks curls; leaf vein = midline with alternating V branches.
checks: Petals radiate from one centre
Curled edges shown by double lines
Foliage reads as a few masses before texture
common_errors: Outlining every leaf of a tree
Flat petals with no turn
Shading strokes that ignore the surface

methods.name_en: Products and vehicles from orthographic views
methods.principle_ar: خطط الشكل في مساقط جانبية وعلوية وأمامية داخل مستطيلات حاوية، ثم انقلها إلى المنظور عبر صندوق حاوٍ. ارسم من الكتف، جرّب الضربة في الهواء ثم ارسمها مرة واحدة، وأدر الورقة. للقطع الناقص صحح المحور الأصغر أولًا ليطابق محور الأسطوانة ثم الدرجة التي تنفتح بالابتعاد عن الأفق. خطوط المقاطع X-Y-Z تصف الأسطح المنحنية، وخط السيلويت هو الأسمك.
methods.principle_en: Plan the form in side, top and front views inside bounding rectangles, then carry it into perspective through a bounding box. Draw from the shoulder, ghost the stroke, then commit once, and rotate the paper. For ellipses fix the minor axis first so it lines up with the cylinder's axis, then the degree, which opens with distance from the horizon. X-Y-Z section lines describe curved surfaces, and the silhouette line is the heaviest.
steps: Side view in a bounding rectangle with proportions
Perspective box at the same proportions
Transfer key points through the box
Wheels and holes: minor axis on the axle line
Section lines on curved surfaces; heavy silhouette, lighter inner lines
methods.code_recipe: Project orthographic key points (x, y, z) through a 2-point camera; draw wheel ellipses with minor axis along the projected axle direction.
prompt_terms: vehicle in two-point perspective with section lines
checks: Ellipse minor axes align with their axles
Both sides of a symmetric object share vanishing points
Silhouette heavier than inner lines
common_errors: Wheels that tilt off the axle
Re-traced hairy lines
Starting details before the box is right

methods.name_en: Cartoon motion symbols and expression shorthand
methods.name_ar: رموز الحركة واختصارات التعبير في الكرتون
methods.principle_ar: الكرتون يضيف إلى الرسم لغة رموز: خطوط سرعة خلف الجسم، خطوط اهتزاز موازية للشيء المهتز، عيون متعددة لالتفاتة سريعة، حدود متقطعة للارتجاف، نجوم ودوامات للدوار، قطرات عرق، علامات استفهام وتعجب. ولكل شعور اختصار: الغضب حواجب تنحدر نحو الأنف وأسنان مطبقة، الملل جفون ثقيلة وفم مستقيم مائل، المكر جفون نصف مغلقة وحاجب مرفوع وبؤبؤ في الزاوية.
methods.principle_en: Cartoons add a symbol language to the drawing: speed lines behind the body, wobble lines parallel to a shaking object, multiple eyes for a fast head turn, broken outlines for trembling, stars and swirls for dizziness, sweat beads, question and exclamation marks. Each feeling has a shorthand: anger = brows sloping down to the nose and gritted teeth, boredom = heavy lids and a flat slanted mouth, slyness = half-closed lids, one raised brow, pupils in the corner.
steps: Get the pose and expression right first
Add one motion symbol that matches the direction of movement
Use the expression shorthand consistently on brows, lids and mouth
Keep symbols light and fewer than the main lines
Use one basic head shape for every character in a strip and swap only the features
Every feature must support the personality; revise the rough until none contradicts it
methods.code_recipe: Speed lines = 3-6 strokes parallel to the motion vector behind the silhouette, tapering away; wobble lines = short arcs offset on both sides of the moving edge.
prompt_terms: comic sweat drops and impact stars
checks: Motion lines are parallel to the movement
Brows, lids and mouth agree on one emotion
Symbols never cover the face
common_errors: Speed lines pointing the wrong way
Symbol overload that hides the pose
Mixed signals between brows and mouth

methods.name_en: Practice regimen and seeing drills
methods.principle_ar: التحسن يأتي من عشر دقائق يوميًا لا من ساعات نادرة. بدّل بين أيام الرسم من الملاحظة وأيام الرسم من الذاكرة، وسخّن بالخط المتصل والرسم الأعمى والرسم المقلوب والفراغ السالب، وارسم الموضوع نفسه بتقنيات مختلفة لتكتشف أسلوبك. للنقل الدقيق استخدم شبكة مربعات خفيفة وارسم مربعًا مربعًا ثم امسحها. راجع العمل بالترتيب: السيلويت ثم الحجم والتفاصيل ثم التكوين.
methods.principle_en: Progress comes from ten minutes a day, not rare long sessions. Alternate observation days with drawing-from-memory days; warm up with continuous-line, blind contour, upside-down copying and negative space; redraw the same subject in many techniques to find a personal style. For an accurate transfer use a light grid and copy cell by cell, then erase it. Review in order: silhouette, then volume and details, then composition.
steps: Three-minute warm-up: continuous or blind contour
Main study from observation, or from memory on alternate days
Compare memory drawing with the reference and list two fixes
Weekly: one subject in five techniques
Use a grid only for likeness-critical copies, then remove it
methods.code_recipe: Track sessions as a dated log; a grid overlay = N x N lines drawn at 20% opacity on both reference and canvas.
checks: Memory drawings are compared against references
Warm-up and study separated
Grid lines removed from finished work
common_errors: Only copying, never drawing from memory
Waiting for free hours
Leaving grid lines visible

methods.name_en: Blueprint, shape, erase, shade, ground
methods.name_ar: المخطط ثم التشكيل ثم المسح ثم التظليل ثم التثبيت بالظل
methods.principle_ar: طريقة البناء التدريجي للمبتدئ: مخطط خفيف من أشكال هندسية، ثم «شكّل الأشكال» بإضافة السمك والانحناء، ثم امسح الخطوط الزائدة، ثم اختر مصدر ضوء وظلّل الجانب المقابل، ثم ثبّت الشيء بظل ساقط هو نسخة مضغوطة منه على الأرض، وأخيرًا أغمق قيمة حيث تتداخل الأشكال. كل شكل يحدد حجم ومكان الشكل التالي.
methods.principle_en: A step-by-step build for beginners: a light blueprint of geometric shapes, then shape the shapes (add thickness and curve), erase the extra lines, choose a light source and shade the opposite side, ground the object with a cast shadow that is a squashed copy of it on the floor, and put the darkest darks where shapes overlap. Each shape sets the size and place of the next one.
steps: Blueprint with light geometric shapes
Refine contours and add thickness
Erase construction lines
Light source -> shade the far side, blend
Cast shadow + darkest accents in overlaps
Teach it by progressive disclosure: show only the new strokes of each step over the previous ones
Check the nine laws on every drawing: foreshortening, placement, size, overlap, shading, shadow, contour, horizon, density
Copy one reference cube's receding directions for every parallel edge, and give every opening a thickness line
Add a 3D edge by drawing a second line that follows the contour, then lift highlights with a kneaded eraser
methods.code_recipe: Matches the stage groups of the SVG demos: guide (blueprint), construction, final; add a cast-shadow polygon offset away from the light.
prompt_terms: simple 3D cartoon object with cast shadow
checks: Blueprint stage exists before final lines
Shadow side opposite the chosen light
Object touches its cast shadow
Flat faces turned from the light get one even value; curved faces get a blended gradient
common_errors: Copying a known character feature by feature with no structure, which fails at any new angle
Pressing hard on the blueprint so it cannot be erased
Shading both sides equally
No cast shadow (floating)

methods.name_en: Anime character types and body ratios by role
methods.name_ar: أنماط شخصيات الأنمي ونسب الجسم حسب الدور
methods.principle_ar: حدد النمط قبل الرسم: شخصية «SD» صغيرة (2–3 رؤوس)، عادية (حوالي 7 رؤوس)، بطولية (7.5–8 وقد تصل 9 بكتفين بعرض ثلاثة رؤوس). الطفل ساقاه إلى الجذع 6:4 ولا يُرسم بوجه بالغ، والمسن خصره أطول. هوية الشخصية ثابتة عبر شكل العين والتسريحة ونسبة الرأس للجسم وسيلويت الملابس، والإكسسوار رمز يستحق أكبر عناية. الوقفة والتعبير يجب أن يتفقا.
methods.principle_en: Pick the type before drawing: super-deformed (2–3 heads), normal (about 7 heads), heroic (7.5–8, up to 9 with shoulders three head-widths wide). A child has legs to upper body about 6:4 and never an adult face; an elder has a longer waist. Identity stays constant through eye shape, hairstyle, head-to-body ratio and costume silhouette, and the signature accessory deserves the most care. Pose and expression must agree.
steps: Choose type and head count
Fix the identity set: eyes, hair, ratio, costume silhouette
Design supporting cast with contrasting heights and shapes
Check pose and expression agree
Make a character sheet and an expression sheet
methods.code_recipe: Use `draw figure --heads N` for the ratio and `draw character --age` for age proportions; store the identity set as JSON with the sheet.
checks: Head count matches the chosen type
Identity set identical across views
Expression fits the pose
common_errors: Adult face on a child body
Equal line weight and symmetry (paper doll)
Sad face on a heroic pose

methods.name_en: Realistic graphite: grid accuracy, blending and lifted lights
methods.name_ar: الرصاص الواقعي: دقة الشبكة والدمج والإضاءة بالممحاة
methods.principle_ar: في الرسم الواقعي الشكل أولًا: لا تقنية تنقذ شكلًا خاطئًا. حدد مساحات الظل كأشكال في مرحلة الخط، ثم ابنِ القيمة بطبقات وادمجها بأداة دمج، وارفع الأضواء بممحاة عجين مدببة. الشعر والحواجب والرموش ضربات مستدقة في اتجاه النمو لا خطوط صلبة، ولا تحيط العين بخط رموش سفلية. الخط الخارجي لا يكون أغمق من الظلال.
methods.principle_en: In realistic drawing shape comes first: no technique saves a wrong shape. Map the shadow areas as shapes during the line stage, build value in layers, blend with a stump, and lift lights with a pointed kneaded eraser. Hair, brows and lashes are tapered strokes in the growth direction, never hard lines, and the eye is never ringed by a line of lower lashes. An outline is never darker than the shadows.
steps: Accurate line drawing (grid if needed) including shadow shapes
Block shadows lightly, then deepen in layers
Blend toward smooth gradients
Lift highlights and light hairs with the eraser
Final darks only in the deepest accents
methods.code_recipe: Use value bands from the reference (posterise to 5 levels) as the shadow-shape layer before any gradient.
checks: Shadow shapes match the reference
No hard outline around soft forms
Brightest lights are lifted or reserved, not drawn
common_errors: Hard straight eyebrow lines
Outline darker than the shadow
Over-blending that removes texture

methods.name_en: Walks and runs: contact, down, passing, up
methods.name_ar: المشي والجري: التلامس ثم الهبوط ثم العبور ثم الصعود
methods.principle_ar: الخطوة أربع وضعيات: تلامس الكعب، ثم «الهبوط» حيث تنثني الساق وتمتص الوزن (أدنى نقطة للجسم)، ثم «العبور» حين تمر الساق الحرة بجوار الحاملة، ثم «الصعود» قبل التلامس التالي. أول ما تراقبه صعود الرأس وهبوطه. الذراعان عكس الساقين على أقواس، والكتفان عكس الحوض، والرأس يتأخر قليلًا. المشي العادي خطوة كل نصف ثانية (12 إطارًا)، والجري جسم مائل للأمام برسمة واحدة على الأقل في الهواء ولا يرتفع أكثر من نصف رأس.
methods.principle_en: A step is four poses: heel contact; the down position where the leg bends and absorbs the weight (the body's lowest point); the passing position where the free leg passes the supporting one; and the up position before the next contact. The first thing to watch is the head's rise and fall. Arms swing opposite to the legs on arcs, shoulders oppose hips, the head trails slightly. A normal walk takes a step every half second (12 frames); a run leans forward, has at least one drawing off the ground and lifts the body no more than half a head.
steps: Draw both contacts, then the passing position between them
Add the down (lowest) and up (highest) positions
Swing arms opposite to legs; hands lowest at passing
Tilt shoulders against hips; delay the head a frame or two
Time it: 12 frames per step for a normal walk, fewer for a run; vary per character
methods.code_recipe: Body height per frame = base - drop*[0,1,0.3,-0.4,0] over contact/down/passing/up/contact; place feet by IK with the support foot fixed while it is on the ground.
checks: The lowest body position is just after contact, the highest just after passing
Arms swing opposite to legs
A run has at least one airborne drawing
common_errors: Body moving at one height (gliding)
Same-side arm and leg forward
Circular body cycles that look like a pigeon

methods.name_en: Creature and game character design pipeline
methods.principle_ar: التصميم يبدأ بكمية: عشرات السيلويتات الصغيرة حول موضوع (وحش، نبات حي، آلي، بشري) ثم اختيار الأقوى، ثم رسم بنائي يحفظ هيكلًا ومفاصل معقولة حتى للخيالي، ثم ألوان أساسية مسطحة، ثم تجسيد كل خامة على حدة (ريش، فرو، خشب، معدن) بضوء واحد. الأسلحة والدروع والإكسسوار تُصمَّم كقطع مستقلة بعدة نسخ ومن أكثر من زاوية، والشكل يتبع الوظيفة.
methods.principle_en: Design starts with quantity: dozens of small silhouettes around a theme (beast, living plant, mech, humanoid), pick the strongest, then a constructed drawing that keeps a plausible skeleton and joints even for fantasy, then flat base colours, then each material rendered on its own (feathers, fur, wood, metal) under one light. Weapons, armour and props are designed as separate pieces in several versions and from more than one view, and form follows function.
steps: Write a one-line concept (role, world, ability)
Thumbnail 12–30 silhouettes; pick by readability
Construct the chosen one on a plausible skeleton
Flat colours: main, secondary, accent
Render material by material; design props separately in A/B versions and a second view
methods.code_recipe: Generate silhouette variants by mutating primitive sizes/positions; score readability by filled-area compactness and unique outline features; keep a JSON spec per prop.
prompt_terms: material rendering of fur metal and feathers
checks: Silhouette reads at thumbnail size
Joints and limbs could plausibly move
Every material keeps the same light direction
common_errors: Rendering before the silhouette works
Decoration with no function
Fantasy anatomy that could not bear weight

methods.name_en: Graphite textures: grazing, push-pull and foliage
methods.name_ar: ملمس الرصاص: الضربة العريضة والدفع والسحب وأوراق الشجر
methods.principle_ar: لكل ملمس حركة يد: «الضربة العريضة» بجانب سن القلم لأسطح مسطحة أو منحنية، و«ضع وادفع واسحب» بضربات قصيرة لكتل الأوراق والأرض الحجرية، والتعرج لأوراق الشجر ثم بناء الهيكل بأشكال سالبة فاتحة ثم كتلة الأوراق. احتفظ بمكتبة علامات لكل خامة، واستخدم إطار رؤية لاختيار جزء من مشهد مزدحم. الفرو والريش ضربات اتجاهية مع إضاءة مرفوعة بالممحاة.
methods.principle_en: Each texture has a hand movement: the grazing stroke with the side of the lead for flat or curved surfaces, put-push-pull short strokes for foliage masses and stony ground, zigzags for foliage, then structure with light negative leaf shapes, then the foliage mass. Keep a mark library per medium, and use a viewfinder to pick an area of interest in a busy scene. Fur and feathers are directional strokes with lights lifted by the eraser.
steps: Test marks for the medium on a swatch page
Lay a tonal block for the mass
Add texture strokes in the surface direction
Cut light negative shapes to show structure
Lift highlights; keep the darkest darks for depth behind light shapes
methods.code_recipe: Texture brush = stochastic short strokes with direction field from the surface normal; foliage = blue-noise points expanded into zigzag clusters masked by the mass shape.
checks: Strokes follow the surface or growth direction
Light negative shapes break up dark masses
Different materials use different marks
common_errors: Outlining each leaf
One stroke type for every material
Smudging texture into flat grey
